title: The reconcile suite needs a load-aware bound, not a fixed -parallel 12
body:
On a host shared with other agents' live runs (load averages 40-81 against 10 cores), internal/reconcile's full suite at the Makefile's -parallel 12 exceeds the 45-minute per-package timeout — two runs of it timed out here with no test failing on its own merits, and the two wall-clock tests that did fail (TestTheSettlementDeadlineIsSpentInTheRunsOwnClock, TestATicksTerminalRefusalHoldsOnlyThatTick) pass alone in 13-15s under the same stripped environment. The Makefile's -parallel 12 measurement assumed a quiet host; a load-scaled parallelism or a wall-clock bound on the wall-clock-sensitive tests would keep the suite's evidence honest on a busy one. This is the epic t8u's own subject (deterministic contention), not something tick pqs should reach into.
evidence: make gate's GOTEST_PARALLEL=12 comment (Makefile:20-27); /tmp/pqs-reconcile-full2.log: two timeouts at 2700s with load 40-81, tests passing alone at 13-15s
